_doc: Where a level stands its weapons of the arena (scripts/stash.gd), where the spot that scripts/arena.gd works out (Arena.hideouts()) is not a good one: {"<level>": {"specials": {"<weapon>": [x, y, z]}}}, the weapon by the name of its file in weapons/. A weapon a level does not name here gets the spot that is worked out. Each spot here was looked at in the game: see PLAN.md, 'Wapens afgebouwd'. A level can also say where the two sides begin, "ends": [[x, y, z], [x, y, z]], where the two spots furthest apart are not the ones to begin at: the walk nearest each counts, at any height.
